plugins.name: cofoundy-orchestrator
plugins.description: AI-native project management substrate for autonomous multi-agent work. Single entry point `/cto` drives a 12-phase loop with 3 AGENT-resolved gates via the `ceo-agent` autonomous role; escalates to human only on threshold breach. Composes 20 skills + 2 new agents (ceo-agent, research-agent). Targets 3+ hours unattended operation. Built on cofoundy-toolkit:sprint + Superpowers.
